metadata_1.title: Licences
metadata_1.description: Single-site, agency and unlimited licences for the Three Acts template — what each allows, and how updates work.

sections_2.heading: What each licence allows
sections_2.body:
A Single-Site Licence covers one production deployment — your own project, or one client's — forever, with no recurring fee for that site.

An Agency Licence covers every client project your studio ships, with no per-site fee, so it pays for itself after two or three client builds for most agencies.

An Unlimited Licence adds unlimited sites under any number of brands, unlimited team seats, and a year of priority support at no extra cost.

sections_2.heading: Updates
sections_2.body: Every licence includes updates to the version line you bought for 12 months from purchase — fixes, security patches and new template capabilities as they ship. Renewing after 12 months is optional; the template keeps working, you just stop receiving new updates until you do.

sections_2.heading: Moving between licences
sections_2.body: Upgrading from a Single-Site to an Agency or Unlimited Licence is a one-time top-up for the price difference — email support and we'll sort it out, no need to buy the higher tier from scratch.

licenses.lede_5: One licence per way you use the template — pick the one that matches how many sites you're shipping.
